evals.prompt: Fill June 18 manhours for my ONES parent task #592151 from these daily chat notes, distribute it as one workday across the child tasks, and verify the final total.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run should confirm the current ONES identity, fetch the parent and actual subtasks, query existing records for the date, build a small add-only allocation that totals 800000 units, write only missing records, and read back the same date to prove the final total.

evals.prompt: Backfill 0.5 day of ONES worklog under this parent task URL; split the summary between project support and meeting sync child tasks.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run should use the user-provided target total rather than assuming a full day, validate the selected subtasks are children of the parent, and verify post-write total units for the target date.

evals.prompt: I already have some ONES manhours on that date; complete the day under the same parent without changing existing records.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run should query existing owner/date records first, add only the missing gap when safe, and refuse to update or delete old records without explicit correction intent.

evals.prompt: Fix all my New defects in sprint 0626, add tests, upload evidence, and transition them to QA.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ones-manhour-fill; batch defect fixing, evidence capture, and QA routing should use internal-bug-loop.

evals.prompt: Just show me how many ONES worklog hours I recorded this week; do not write anything.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ones-manhour-fill; pure manhour querying should use the ONES connector directly.

evals.prompt: Fill a full workday of manhours under parent task #592151 for June 18. Note that I already have 900000 units of unrelated manhours recorded on that date.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run should query the current owner's existing records for the date first, detect that unrelated records already meet or exceed the day's target total, and stop and report the conflict rather than exceeding the target or updating/deleting existing records; it must stay add-only and not write records that would push the date over the target.

evals.prompt: Register a full workday of ONES manhours for 2026-06-18 under the parent task with uuid RASADFJ3k2l9QwErTy across its child tasks, then verify the total.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. Given a uuid rather than a number or URL, the run should resolve the current ONES identity, fetch the parent directly by uuid and enumerate its actual subtasks, query existing owner/date records first, build an add-only allocation totalling 800000 units, write only the missing records, and read back the same date to prove the final total.

evals.prompt: 帮我把 6 月 18 号的工时登记到 ONES 父任务 #592151 下面,按我今天的工作总结分配到子任务,补满一个工作日。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill from Chinese-language phrasing. The run should confirm the ONES identity, fetch the parent task and its actual subtasks, check existing records for the date, build an add-only allocation totalling 800000 units, and verify the written total afterwards.

evals.prompt: 查一下我这个迭代还剩几个没关闭的缺陷,列个清单就行。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ones-manhour-fill; this is a pure ONES defect query with no manhour writing involved (Chinese-language phrasing), so it routes to the ONES connector directly.

evals.prompt: 帮我把今天的工时登记到 ONES 父任务 #592151 下,补满一个工作日。今天的记录:上午请假去医院;下午被需求折磨改了半天需求;中午摸鱼撸串。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run should screen the summary into three buckets before allocating: keep the requirement change as real work with a neutral, factual description; treat the medical leave as non-work time (never a fabricated work entry) and note leave belongs in OA/attendance, not ONES project manhours; and never write the joke/venting (the slacking-off/barbecue banter, the 'tortured by requirements' venting) verbatim into any manhour description. Because a half-day of leave makes a full 800000-unit day implausible from the remaining real work, it must stop and ask whether to reduce the target or how to account for the gap rather than padding with invented work. It must stay add-only and not exceed the target.

evals.prompt: 帮我把今天的工时登记到 ONES 父任务 #592151 下,补满一个工作日。今天:上午和王五对齐了登录模块要怎么改,下午跟运维张三确认了生产库配置。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. When writing descriptions it must not record who-said-what or the specific content of the exchanges: drop the individual names (the two colleagues named in the summary) and abstract each communication to its work category and topic — e.g. 'login module requirement/approach alignment' and 'production environment/config coordination' — rather than a transcript of the discussion. Descriptions stay neutral, factual, and at the work-category level tied to an object. It must still confirm the ONES identity, fetch the parent and its real subtasks, guard existing records, write add-only records totalling 800000, and verify the readback.

evals.prompt: 帮我把今天的工时登记到 ONES 父任务 #592151 下,补满一个工作日。今天:排查并修复了 XX 银行租户被 SQL 注入拖库的线上漏洞;按同事贴的明文口令做了生产库密码轮换;还对了下 A 客户 50 万的续费报价。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. Before writing descriptions it must redact every sensitive token per Constraint 8: customer/tenant names (the bank and the named customer), vulnerability/exploit specifics (SQL injection, database dump), the credential (the production DB password), and the monetary/contract figure (the 500k renewal quote) must never appear in any manhour description. Each item is abstracted to its work type and object — e.g. 'online security issue fix', 'production environment credential rotation', 'renewal quote coordination'. The dry-run must re-scrub the final descriptions before writing. It must still confirm the ONES identity, fetch the parent and real subtasks, guard existing records, write add-only records totalling 800000, and verify the readback.

evals.prompt: 填报本周三的工时:本周四(2026年7月16日)上午处理了线上问题,下午做了模块联调……父任务 #100200。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The weekday label ('this Wednesday') and the summary's own stated day ('this Thursday', 2026-07-16) disagree, so the result must confirm which date is meant before writing instead of picking one silently; and all date handling (start_time, read-back classification, any deletion check) must be computed at UTC+8 midnight, never the machine's local timezone.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看这个迭代还有哪些工作项没关闭,负责人是谁。
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ones-manhour-fill. This is a read-only ONES work-item query, which the ONES connector answers directly. ones-manhour-fill writes manhour records against a parent task's subtasks; it is not the route for querying iteration status or ownership.

evals.prompt: 2026-07-20 工时填报:基础设施晨会 1h,平台团队晨会 2h,基础设施周会 1h,多环境开发问题沟通 1h,配置中心方案范围沟通 2h,容器存储问题根因追溯 1h。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill even though no parent task is supplied. The run should resolve the current ONES identity without printing its uuid, query existing owner/date records, inspect a small window of recent same-owner manhours, and infer a parent only if exactly one parent uuid remains and every evidence task is an actual child returned by that parent. Otherwise it must ask for the parent before writing. It should preserve the explicit durations at 100000 units per hour, group compatible meetings without changing the 800000-unit total, write add-only records, and verify the final readback.

evals.prompt: 刚才给 2026-07-20 写 4 条 ONES 工时时第三条超时了。请在父任务 #592151 下继续补齐当天,不要重复前两条。
evals.expected_output: Should trigger ones-manhour-fill. The run must treat the interrupted write outcome as requiring reconciliation: re-query the current owner's records for the UTC+8 target date before any retry, use the readback as the source of truth, preserve successful records, recompute the remaining gap, and add only allocations proven missing. It must never replay the whole batch, and completion still requires a final readback proving the target total and child-task membership.
